newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan shares fall on dim view of restructure plan.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan shares fall on dim view of restructure plan.

text.p: Shares in Yaohan Japan Corp fell sharply in Thursday's morning session on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as participants shrugged off its recently announced restructuring plan as insufficient, dealers said.
The shares ended the morning session at 340 yen, down 40 yen from the previous day's closing.
Yaohan Japan, the flagship firm of the Yaohan international retailing group, announced earlier this week that it would trim group assets by over 30 percent in the next two years.
The company, burdened by hefty borrowings after aggressive expansion overseas, has sought financial assistance from banks for operating funds.
